dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, who do you find inspiring?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhuː duː juː ˈfaɪnd ɪnˈspaɪərɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ratchanok Intanon, the badminton player. She was the youngest woman ever to become world champion.
dialogue.reading: ˈrætʃənɑːk ˈɪntənɑːn, ðə ˈbædmɪntən ˈpleɪər. ʃiː wʌz ðə ˈjʌŋɪst ˈwʊmən ˈɛvər tə bɪˈkʌm ˈwɜːrld ˈtʃæmpiən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Only eighteen. And she was the first Thai player ever to win it.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ˌeɪˈtiːn. ənd ʃiː wʌz ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪ ˈpleɪər ˈɛvər tə ˈwɪn ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What an amazing victory! My hero is a runner, Eliud Kipchoge.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ən əˈmeɪzɪŋ ˈvɪktəri! maɪ ˈhɪroʊ ɪz ə ˈrʌnər, ˈɛliəd kɪpˈtʃoʊɡeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, I know him! Wasn't he the first person to run a marathon in under two hours?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈnoʊ hɪm! ˈwʌzənt hiː ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈpɜːrsən tə ˈrʌn ə ˈmærəθɑːn ɪn ˈʌndər ˈtuː ˈaʊərz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. It wasn't an official world record, but it showed the world what's possible.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪt ˈwʌzənt ən əˈfɪʃəl ˈwɜːrld ˈrɛkərd, bʌt ɪt ˈʃoʊd ðə ˈwɜːrld ˈwʌts ˈpɑːsəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's so inspiring. Do you think winners are born or made?
dialogue.reading: ðæts soʊ ɪnˈspaɪərɪŋ. duː juː ˈθɪŋk ˈwɪnərz ər ˈbɔːrn ɔːr ˈmeɪd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Made, mostly. Even gold medal winners start as beginners.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪd, ˈmoʊstli. ˈiːvən ˈɡoʊld ˈmɛdəl ˈwɪnərz ˈstɑːrt əz bɪˈɡɪnərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I like that. Maybe I can be the first person in my family to open a school!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈðæt. ˈmeɪbi aɪ kən bi ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈpɜːrsən ɪn maɪ ˈfæməli tə ˈoʊpən ə ˈskuːl!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Why not? The only way to know is to try.
dialogue.reading: ˈwaɪ ˈnɑːt? ði ˈoʊnli ˈweɪ tə ˈnoʊ ɪz tə ˈtraɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're right. One day, I'm going to try!
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtraɪ!
